system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

Trial: ODYSSEY OUTCOMES NCT01663402 - ODYSSEY Outcomes: Evaluation of Cardiovascular Outcomes After an Acute Coronary Syndrome During Treatment With Alirocumab
Investigational drug: alirocumab
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01663402 (registry, published 2012-08-13, source ctgov:NCT01663402@2018-03-10)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT01663402 ()
Title: ODYSSEY Outcomes: Evaluation of Cardiovascular Outcomes After an Acute Coronary Syndrome During Treatment With Alirocumab
Official title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Study to Evaluate the Effect of Alirocumab (SAR236553/REGN727) on the Occurrence of Cardiovascular Events in Patients Who Have Recently Experienced an Acute Coronary Syndrome
Sponsor: Sanofi
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease
Interventions: Alirocumab (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG); LMT (DRUG)
Start date: 2012-10
Enrollment: 18924 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Time to First Occurrence of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event (MACE); Percentage of Observed Participants With Outcome Measure Events During the Study [From randomization up to 64 months]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion criteria :

Recently (\< 52 weeks) hospitalized for ACS.

Exclusion criteria:

* Age \< 40 years.
* ACS event occurring more than 52 weeks prior to randomization visit.
* LDL-C likely to be \<70 mg/dL (\<1.81 mmo/L), and apolipoprotein B (ApoB) \<80 mg/dL (\<0.8 g/L), and non - high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) \<100 mg/dL (\<2.59 mmol/L) with evidence-based medical and dietary management of dyslipidemia.

The above information is not intended to contain all considerations relevant to a participant's potential participation in a clinical trial.
Brief summary: Primary Objective:

To compare the effect of alirocumab with placebo on the occurrence of cardiovascular (CV) events (composite endpoint of coronary heart disease (CHD) death, non-fatal myocardial infarction (MI), fatal and non-fatal ischemic stroke, unstable angina (UA) requiring hospitalization) in participants who experienced an acute coronary syndrome (ACS) event 4 to 52 weeks prior to randomization and were treated with evidence-based medical and dietary management of dyslipidemia. Secondary Objectives:

* To evaluate the effect of alirocumab on secondary endpoints (any CHD event , major CHD event, any CV event, composite of all cause mortality/non-fatal MI/non-fatal ischemic stroke, CHD deaths, CV deaths, all cause mortality). * To evaluate the safety and tolerability of alirocumab. * To evaluate the effect of alirocumab on lipid parameters.
--- END ---
